name: Phone alerts (ntfy)
summary: Free · app for iPhone and Android · can run on your own server
help: Install the free ntfy app, subscribe to the topic below, and Library sends alerts to it.
what_leaves: The alert text. With ntfy.sh it passes through their servers (and Apple or Google to reach an iPhone or Android). Anyone who knows the topic can read the alerts, so keep it private.

fields.label: Server
fields.help: Leave it as ntfy.sh, or enter the address of your own server.

fields.label: Topic
fields.help: Keep it private: anyone who knows it can read the alerts.

fields.label: Access token
fields.help: Only if your server needs a sign-in.
